summary_short.zh: Karakeep 是一款可自托管的书签管理应用，支持保存链接、笔记和图片，旨在解决数字信息杂乱问题。核心能力在于利用本地AI模型自动为内容打标签，并提供全文搜索，让检索变得直观。其技术亮点是AI分类与搜索的结合，无需依赖外部服务。使用方法简单：通过Docker一键部署，配合浏览器扩展快速收藏，还可利用API自定义工作流。适合个人知识管理、研究资料整理，打造属于自己的书签库。

summaries.en: Karakeep is a self-hostable bookmark manager that saves links, notes, and images. It solves the problem of organizing digital clutter by using AI for automatic tagging and full-text search. Technically, it leverages local AI models to classify content and make retrieval intuitive. You can self-host via Docker, integrate browser extensions for quick saving, and extend functionality through its API for custom workflows or personal knowledge management.

summary_short.zh: Gas Town 是一个开源的多智能体工作空间管理器，专为需要多个AI代理协作完成复杂任务的场景设计。其核心通过共享工作空间来管理代理间的状态与上下文，实现高效的沟通与任务委派，保证多步骤工作流的一致性与可追踪性。开发者可利用Go语言定义不同代理角色并编排工作流程，快速搭建自动化研究、内容生成或软件开发等领域的多代理协作系统，从而提升任务执行效率与灵活性。

summaries.en: Gas Town is an open-source multi-agent workspace manager that orchestrates teams of AI agents to collaborate on complex tasks. It uses a shared workspace to manage state and context across agents, enabling coherent multi-step workflows through task delegation and communication. Developers define agent roles and workflows in Go, then deploy Gas Town to automate research, content generation, or software development pipelines where multiple specialized agents need to cooperate efficiently.

summary_short.zh: claude-video 使 Claude 模型能够“观看”视频，弥补动态视觉内容与静态文本理解的鸿沟。它下载视频后提取代表性帧，通过 Whisper 转录语音，再将视觉与音频上下文一并交给 Claude 推理。技术上将时域视频转化为适合 Claude 上下文窗口的多模态提示，采用帧采样与转写而非实时处理。输入 `/watch [链接]` 即可分析课程录像、总结会议或审查内容。适合需要 AI 视频理解而无须定制管线的团队。

summaries.en: Claude-video enables Anthropic’s Claude model to “watch” videos by bridging dynamic visual content and static text understanding. It downloads a video, extracts representative frames, transcribes speech via Whisper, and sends both visual and audio context to Claude for reasoning. Technically, it converts temporal video data into a multimodal prompt within Claude’s context window using frame sampling and transcription rather than real-time processing. Users can analyze lecture recordings, summarize meeting videos, or moderate content by running `/watch [URL or file]` to receive insights. This tool suits teams needing AI video understanding without custom pipelines.
